criteria.title: Preserve old ownership on failed nonzero resize and invalidate all prior aliases after successful resize even if an address token is reused.
criteria.task: Implement the nonzero resize wrapper using a temporary result and deterministic refusal seam. On success initialize new tail bytes and rebuild all published borrows from the returned owner; use integer histories to model same-address reuse.
criteria.purpose: A same-address success preserves old aliases or assigning realloc directly to the owner preserves failure state.
